title: About

seo.metaTitle: About Catalyst Bible College | Visalia, California
seo.metaDescription: Catalyst Bible College is powered by Nelson University and hosted by Visalia First in California's Central Valley. Meet our leadership, board, and faculty.

tagline: Where everyone majors in changing the world.
subhead: Catalyst Bible College is powered by Nelson University.

blocks.heading: About Our Campus
blocks.body:
With meager beginnings in 1928, brave men and women of God overcame relentless spiritual attacks and built Visalia First on prayer and the presence of God.

Our world is changing at lightning speed, but there is one thing that has not changed: the power of the Gospel and a Spirit-filled church. In every adult service for the past 27 years, someone has accepted Jesus as their Savior and committed their life to Him. With multiple ministries and services happening throughout the week, lives are consistently being changed for the Kingdom!

Students of Catalyst Bible College have the incredible opportunity to work alongside strong ministry leaders at Visalia First as they develop leadership skills, a strong network of peers, and a deep knowledge of the Bible.
blocks._migrationNotes: 'the past 27 years' is a hardcoded number that silently ages. Consider storing a start year and computing, or rewriting to a fixed phrase.

blocks.heading: Location
blocks.body:
Located strategically in the Central Valley of California, Visalia First is under an hour away from Sequoia National Park, three hours away from Los Angeles, and two hours from the nearest beach.

Our campus is in the perfect location to have hands-on ministry experience across our partner churches.
blocks._migrationNotes: Source read 'the Sequoia National Park' and 'two hours to the nearest beach'. Lightly corrected.

blocks.heading: Student Scholarships
blocks.body:
Visalia First and Catalyst Bible College are committed to producing credentialed, high-functioning ministers for the Assemblies of God with little to no debt. This is why we are offering more than $100,000 worth of scholarships for students to apply for each year. The average CBC student will graduate receiving close to $10,000 in scholarship dollars.

Contact us for more information on how to apply for scholarships and become a CBC scholar.

blocks.heading: Practicums
blocks.body:
We want all of our students to be well-versed in all aspects of ministry, and practicums are one way we are able to do this. Each student will rotate through Catalyst Bible College's practicum focuses. These areas have been carefully curated to emphasize key elements of ministry and leadership development.

Practicums are required for Church Leadership majors, but can also be utilized as a resource for our other offered degree programs. Each student not in the Church Leadership program is highly encouraged to participate in practicums.

blocks.heading: Catalyst World Experience
blocks.body:
One of the goals of CBC is for every student to graduate with a passion and heart for missions. That is why we have developed the Catalyst World Experience. Every eligible student will have the opportunity to visit five foreign countries during their four years with Catalyst. These experiences come at no additional cost to the student through generous partners and donations. We aim to visit South America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and the Holy Land before a student graduates our program.

To learn more about the Catalyst World Experience, set up a meeting with our Admissions Office.

seo.metaTitle: Catalyst World Experience | Mission Trips at Catalyst Bible College
seo.metaDescription: Every eligible CBC student visits five countries in four years at no additional cost. Read where our students have served, from Medellin to South Africa.

blocks.body: One of the goals of CBC is for every student to graduate with a passion and heart for missions. That is why we have developed the Catalyst World Experience. Every eligible student will have the opportunity to visit five foreign countries during their four years with Catalyst. These experiences come at no additional cost to the student through generous partners and donations. We aim to visit South America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and the Holy Land before a student graduates our program.

Our Year One students had the opportunity to visit Medellin, Colombia and work hand-in-hand with missionaries Corey and Tona Kautz. Students were able to minister to children, teens, adults, and the homeless community in Medellin for seven days.

Our Year Two students went to South Africa to work with missionaries Rudi and Sharon Swanepoel. In their ten day trip, students saw over 10,000 salvations through kids ministry crusades and concluded the trip with an immersive safari experience.

title: Student Life

seo.metaTitle: Student Life at Catalyst Bible College | Chapel, Housing, Community
seo.metaDescription: Weekly chapel, leadership labs, monthly community activities, and student housing at $450 a month including utilities.

items.heading: Student Chapel
items.body: All on-campus students will be asked to attend one chapel service a week and sign up for a small group in their respective ministry area, such as Young Adults or Adults. Chapel services are traditionally held on Wednesdays and last 60 minutes. Services are devotional in nature and feature guest speakers.

items.heading: Networking Opportunities
items.body: Students will be able to interact, network, and learn from prominent leaders across the country multiple times each semester. Students will also have the chance to engage with local community leaders during their time as students.

items.heading: Community Life
items.body: Monthly, students will be able to participate in a community-building activity such as bowling, laser tag, a movie, or a family dinner.

items.heading: Leadership Labs and Crossfire
items.body: Each week, students gain practical insights on future career preparation through Leadership Labs. In addition to Labs, students participate in Crossfire discussions that challenge their worldview and encourage them to dive deep into the Bible.
items._migrationNotes: Source read 'Crossfire discussion that challenge their worldview and encourages them to deep dive'. Corrected for agreement.

blocks.heading: Student Housing
blocks.body:
Catalyst Bible College student housing is available to enrolled CBC students. To qualify for student housing, you must be an active, enrolled student with CBC and apply through the Catalyst offices prior to the start of the semester. Students who live more than an hour outside of campus receive priority placement.

CBC has the ability to house full-time students just minutes away from our Visalia campus. Students pay $450 per month including rent, utilities, and house furniture. Students will have one or two roommates when they live in CBC student housing. Students are not required to live in student housing while enrolled.

Contact the Catalyst Student Success Office for housing policies and payment information.

seo.metaTitle: Apply to Catalyst Bible College | Application Instructions
seo.metaDescription: Step-by-step instructions for applying to Catalyst Bible College through the Nelson University application portal.

blocks.heading: Applying to Catalyst Bible College
blocks.intro: When applying to Catalyst Bible College, you will create an application with Nelson University first.

items.body: Choose **Create an Account** under First Time Users.
Complete the form that asks for your email address, first name, last name, and birthdate.
You will receive a temporary PIN by email. From there, you will be asked to create a password for your Nelson application account.

Once your password is set, select **Start New Application**. Choose **Main Application** and **Undergraduate Partner Site Admissions Application**. If you are applying for a graduate program, select **Graduate Admissions Application**.
Under the **Applicant Information** tab, select your site from the dropdown menu.
items._migrationNotes: Hardcoded as 'Visalia, CA // Catalyst Bible College' on the live site. Now pulled from the site record, so each network site page shows the correct value instead of sending every applicant to Visalia.

items.body: Everything that remains on the application is personal and academic history. If you need assistance completing the application, please contact our CBC offices.

blocks.heading: SOM Site Approval
blocks.body: Once your application is completed, every student will be presented to the Catalyst Bible College staff for approval. It will be noted in your application's outstanding items as "SOM Site Approval." The CBC staff will determine if you are an eligible candidate for enrolling and notify Nelson of the decision for acceptance.

title: Becoming a Catalyst Site

seo.metaTitle: Become a Catalyst Bible College Network Site | Partner With Us
seo.metaDescription: Churches can host an accredited Catalyst Bible College site. Review the partnership criteria and start a conversation with our team.

blocks.heading: How to Become a Catalyst Site
blocks.intro: Churches interested in hosting a Catalyst Bible College site must meet the following criteria:
items: Schedule a call to meet with a member of the Catalyst Bible College team.
Determine a semester start with a four-month runway.
Have a minimum of five students wanting to enroll for the start of their semester.
Designate one staff person to serve as the liaison to the CBC main campus.
Agree to cover expenses related to staff training and classroom start up.
